_comment: Checks that are KNOWN to fail right now, with the reason and the condition that
clears them. A baselined check still shows as FAIL in the report and in the pull
request comment — this file never changes what is reported, only whether CI treats
the run as a REGRESSION. The gate asks 'did this change break something new', which
is a question a red baseline can still answer.
Every entry needs a 'clears_when'. A baseline without an exit condition is just a
disabled check, and the pipeline warns when a baselined check starts passing so the
entry gets deleted instead of quietly becoming a permanent blind spot.
_system_under_test: IMPORTANT, and not obvious: this suite does NOT test the in-cluster deployment.
config.json points the console at localhost:8095 on the jump host, which is a
systemd service running a binary built from a loose copy of the source at
/home/hami/phorvex-src — not a git checkout, and not managed by ArgoCD:
The console streams /api/live from an audit FILE, and the file is written by that
kill-switched local operator. The in-cluster operator runs without --audit-json and
so writes no such file, which is why this second stack exists at all.
Consequence: an ArgoCD rollout changes NOTHING that these checks observe. Both
entries below clear only when the jump-host binaries are rebuilt from current

A07.reason: The jump-host operator binary predates the killSwitch stamp on model.Decision / audit.Record / runner.processTenant, so a kill-switched decision is byte-identical in the audit to one whose actuator failed. That operator runs WITH --global-kill-switch, which is exactly the case the stamp exists to distinguish.
A07.clears_when: phorvex-operator.service on the jump host runs a binary built from this source

A05.reason: The jump-host console binary predates voice being added to armedWorkloads, so it answers the attack POST with 'namespace not armed for live attack: voice (armed: litellm, mock-rag-chatbot, phorvex-live-demo)' — naming two namespaces that no longer exist — and no decision can change. Read from attackResponse in the run JSON, not inferred from the absence of a reaction.
A05.clears_when: phorvex-console.service on the jump host runs a binary built from this source
